title: Six more `skills/objectui/evals` assertions grade tokens their own guide never teaches, and one passes only by accidental substring match
body:
Filed out-of-scope from the #7251 skills-optimization flight, which corrected three evals of this class (OUI-H-01, H-03, H-04) and left these. Unassigned.

Every `must_contain` entry is a claim that a correct answer will contain that literal substring. When the token appears nowhere in the guide the eval is scoring, the eval grades a decision the package never taught: a correct answer fails, and an answer that invents the token passes. That is the failure mode #7251 fixed in `evals/mobile.json`, where the eval demanded `useSwipe` / `useLongPress` — zero occurrences repo-wide.

## Remaining rows

**Untaught tokens (OUI-H-05).** Four assertions require tokens absent from the guide they score:

| Eval | Token | Occurrences in its guide |
|---|---|---|
| `evals/mobile.json` eval 1 | `sidebar` | 0 in `guides/mobile.md` |
| `evals/project-setup.json` eval 3 | `ComponentRegistry` | 0 in `guides/project-setup.md` |
| `evals/testing.json` eval 2 | `edit` | 0 in `guides/testing.md` |
| `evals/page-builder.json` eval 3 | `refresh` | 0 in `guides/page-builder.md` |

(`evals/page-builder.json` eval 2 also requires `section`, which is likewise absent; #7251 removed the `props` token from that same assertion but left `section` alone, being out of its funded list.)

**Untaught API, plus a substring accident (OUI-H-02).** Three assertions across `evals/plugin-development.json` and `evals/page-builder.json` require `registerComponent`. The API is real — `PluginScope.registerComponent(type, component, meta?)`, documented in its own docblock at `packages/types/src/plugin-scope.ts` — but every guide teaches registration only as `ComponentRegistry.register(...)`, so the package's own eval contradicts its own guide. Two of those evals also require `FieldWidgetProps`, whereas the guide and the implementation both use `FieldWidgetComponentProps`; the assertion passes only because `FieldWidgetPropsSchema` happens to contain the shorter string.

**A second substring accident, found while working #7251 and not in the audit.** `evals/mobile.json` eval 2 requires `useOffline`. `packages/mobile/src/index.ts` exports `useOfflineSync`, not `useOffline` — the assertion passes on the substring, and would go on passing if the real hook were renamed to something else entirely that happened to start the same way.

## Two ways to close it, and they are not equivalent

1. **Fix the assertion** where the eval is testing a real decision with the wrong token — the `FieldWidgetProps` → `FieldWidgetComponentProps` and `useOffline` → `useOfflineSync` rows are this, and are mechanical.
2. **Teach the thing** where the token names a real surface the package should cover. `registerComponent` is this: it is the API a plugin author actually gets, and `guides/plugin-development.md` never mentions it. Adding a short row there makes three evals honest at once.

Deciding which per row is the work; a blanket delete of the tokens would lose case 2.

## The structural half

None of this is catchable today: nothing validates an eval fixture against the guide it names, and `evals/*.json` is checked by no gate at all. A ~30-line check that every `must_contain` token occurs somewhere in `skills/objectui/**` would have caught every row above, including the two substring accidents if it compared whole tokens. Worth considering alongside #7359.
